exposure: Repeat cesarean delivery with spontaneous labor
management without induction or augmentation of labor
Repeat cesarean delivery without spontaneous labor
cohort: 333 women with singleton gestations and one prior low-transverse cesarean delivery who intended VBAC at 36 weeks of gestation
finding: Management of candidates for VBAC without induction or augmentation of labor resulted in a high VBAC rate (72.7%) and favorable perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Management of candidates for VBAC without induction or augmentation of labor resulted in a high VBAC rate (72.7%) and favorable perinatal outcomes.
